description: Get notices about a Polish company published in the Court and Commercial Gazette (Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy): calls to creditors, liquidation, mergers and transformations. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company_court_gazette
title: Get Court and Commercial Gazette (MSiG)
